kurals.tr: Ellaamai Ventuvaan Enpaan Enaiththondrum / Kallaamai Kaakkadhan Nenju
kurals.m: Let him, who desires not to be despised, keep his mind from (the desire of) defrauding another of the smallest thing

kurals.tr: Ullaththaal Ullalum Theedhe Piranporulaik / Kallaththaal Kalvem Enal
kurals.m: Even the thought (of sin) is sin; think not then of crafiily stealing the property of another

kurals.tr: Kalavinaal Aakiya Aakkam Alavirandhu / Aavadhu Polak Ketum
kurals.m: The property, which is acquired by fraud, will entirely perish, even while it seems to increase

kurals.tr: Kalavinkan Kandriya Kaadhal Vilaivinkan / Veeyaa Vizhumam Tharum
kurals.m: The eager desire of defrauding others will, when it brings forth its fruit, produce undying sorrow

kurals.tr: Arulkarudhi Anputaiya Raadhal Porulkarudhip / Pochchaappup Paarppaarkan Il
kurals.m: The study of kindness and the exercise of benevolence is not with those who watch for another's forgetfulness, though desire of his property

kurals.tr: Alavinkan Nindrozhukal Aatraar Kalavinkan / Kandriya Kaadha Lavar
kurals.m: They cannot walk steadfastly, according to rule, who eagerly desire to defraud others

kurals.tr: Kalavennum Kaarari Vaanmai Alavennum / Aatral Purindhaarkanta Il
kurals.m: That black-knowledge which is called fraud, is not in those who desire that greatness which is called rectitude

kurals.tr: Alavarindhaar Nenjath Tharampola Nirkum / Kalavarindhaar Nenjil Karavu
kurals.m: Deceit dwells in the mind of those who are conversant with fraud, even as virtue in the minds of those who are conversant with rectitude

kurals.tr: Alavalla Seydhaange Veevar Kalavalla / Matraiya Thetraa Thavar
kurals.m: Those, who are acquainted with nothing but fraud, will perish in the very commission of transgression

kurals.tr: Kalvaarkkuth Thallum Uyirnilai Kalvaarkkuth / Thallaadhu Puththe Lulaku
kurals.m: Even their body will fail the fraudulent; but even the world of the gods will not fail those who are free from fraud
